widget.name: AG Grid
widget.description: Advanced data grid using AG Grid

property.caption: Data source
property.description: The data source for the grid

property.caption: Row Model
property.description: Choose Client-Side for small datasets or Server-Side for large datasets.

property.caption: Data Loader Microflow
property.description: Name of the Microflow (e.g. 'MyModule.DS_GetGridData') that accepts an AG Grid Request JSON and returns a Response JSON.

property.caption: Entity Name
property.description: The entity type being retrieved (helper for OQL generation).

property.caption: Cache Block Size
property.description: Number of rows fetched per block from the server. Larger values reduce requests but increase memory. Default: 100.

property.caption: Max Blocks in Cache
property.description: Maximum number of blocks kept in memory. 0 = unlimited (keep all fetched blocks). Reduce to limit memory for very large datasets.

property.caption: Max Concurrent Requests
property.description: Maximum number of simultaneous data requests to the server. Higher values may improve perceived speed but increase server load. Default: 2.

property.caption: Columns
property.description: Define the columns to display

property.caption: Header
property.description: Column header text

property.caption: Attribute
property.description: Attribute to display

property.caption: Data Type
property.description: Override how the grid interprets this column for sorting, filtering, and formatting. Auto uses the Mendix attribute type.

property.caption: Hidden Column
property.description: Keep this column hidden in the grid UI while still allowing it to participate in filters, sorts, or templates.

property.caption: Text Alignment
property.description: Horizontal alignment of cell content. Auto uses smart defaults: numbers/dates right-aligned, text left-aligned, links/badges centered.

property.caption: Width Type
property.description: How to size this column

property.caption: Fixed Width (px)
property.description: Column width in pixels (only used when Width Type is "Fixed")

property.caption: Flex Value
property.description: Flex ratio for flexible columns (like CSS 1fr, 2fr, etc. - only used when Width Type is "Flexible")

property.caption: Minimum Width (px)
property.description: Minimum width for flexible and auto columns

property.caption: Maximum Width (px)
property.description: Maximum width for flexible and auto columns (0 = no limit)

property.caption: Resizable
property.description: Enable column resizing

property.caption: Draggable
property.description: Allow this column to be reordered by dragging the column header

property.caption: Pinned Position
property.description: Pin this column to the left or right side of the grid header.

property.caption: Allow Pin in Menu
property.description: Allow end users to pin or unpin this column through the column options menu.

property.caption: Wrap Text
property.description: Enable text wrapping in this column. When the grid's Row Height Mode is set to Auto, rows will expand to fit the wrapped content. Works best with long text fields like descriptions or notes.

property.caption: Sortable
property.description: Enable sorting for this column

property.caption: Default Sort
property.description: Set initial sort direction for this column when grid loads

property.caption: Sort Priority
property.description: Order for multi-column sorting (0 = first, 1 = second, etc.). ALL or NOTHING: Either assign sortIndex to ALL sortable columns, or leave ALL at default (999). Partial configuration will show an error.

property.caption: Include in Sort Options
property.description: Make this column available in the sort dropdown

property.caption: Filter
property.description: Enable filtering for this column

property.caption: Filter Location
property.description: Where to display the filter for this column

property.caption: Use Date Range Picker
property.description: Show start and end date inputs in the filter drawer instead of a list of values. Only applies to date attributes.

property.caption: Use Relative Date Range
property.description: Show a dropdown of relative ranges (last 7 days, last 30 days, etc.) in the filter drawer. Only applies to date attributes.

property.caption: Floating Filter
property.description: Show the filter below the column header.

property.caption: Enable Aggregation
property.description: Enable aggregation for this column. Aggregations appear in the status bar when rows are selected, and in column footers when enabled.

property.caption: Aggregation Function
property.description: The aggregation function to use for this column

property.caption: Enable Row Group
property.description: Enable this column for row grouping. When enabled, rows will be grouped by the values in this column.

property.caption: Row Group Index
property.description: Order for multi-level grouping (0 = first level, 1 = second level, etc.). Lower values group first.

property.caption: Show in Group Column
property.description: Display this column's values in the auto-generated group column instead of its own column.

property.caption: Formatter (Built-in)
property.description: Format the cell value display using built-in formatters

property.caption: Custom Formatter Name
property.description: Name of a custom formatter to use (e.g., "BadgeMaker"). If specified, this overrides the built-in formatter above. Must match a formatter name from the Custom Formatters configuration.

property.caption: Custom Prefix
property.description: Text to prepend to the value (e.g., "VAF ", "ID-", "#")

property.caption: Custom Suffix
property.description: Text to append to the value (e.g., " kg", " units", "%")

property.caption: Template
property.description: Optional template to display instead of the raw value. Use ${attributeId} placeholders referencing column attributes (including hidden ones).

property.caption: Editable
property.description: Allow inline editing for this column.

property.caption: Editor Type
property.description: The type of editor to use for inline editing.

property.caption: Select Options (JSON)
property.description: JSON array for select/richSelect values. Example: ["Open","Closed"] or [{"value":"Open","label":"Open"}].

property.caption: Required
property.description: Disallow empty values when editing.

property.caption: Min Value
property.description: Minimum value for number/date editors. Leave empty for no minimum.

property.caption: Max Value
property.description: Maximum value for number/date editors. Leave empty for no maximum.

property.caption: Validation Pattern
property.description: Regex pattern the value must match.

property.caption: Link Action
property.description: Action to execute when link is clicked (Show Page, Microflow, Nanoflow, etc.). The context object will be the row's data object.

property.caption: Link URL (Legacy)
property.description: LEGACY: URL pattern with ${value} placeholder. Prefer using Link Action for proper Mendix navigation.

property.caption: Link Text (optional)
property.description: Custom text for the link. Leave empty to use the cell value. Supports ${value} placeholder.

property.caption: Status Mapping (JSON)
property.description: JSON array for status badge mapping. Example: [{"value":1,"label":"Approved","className":"badge-success"},{"value":2,"label":"Denied","className":"badge-danger"}]

property.caption: Enable Column Menus
property.description: Show the three-dot menu icon in column headers. Disable to hide column menu access globally for all columns.

property.caption: Header Filter Buttons
property.description: Show filter icons in column headers. Disable to hide header filter icons while keeping filtering capability for toolbar/drawer filters.

property.caption: Enable Floating Filters
property.description: Show floating filter rows below column headers by default. Individual columns can override this setting.

property.caption: Show Toolbar
property.description: Show the toolbar above the grid. When disabled, the toolbar (view selector, search, filters, export buttons, etc.) is completely hidden. Individual toolbar features like search and filter drawer can still be configured but will not be visible.

property.caption: Enable View Selector
property.description: Show grid/list/card view selector

property.caption: Default View (Desktop)
property.description: Default view mode on desktop screens

property.caption: Default View (Mobile)
property.description: Default view mode on mobile screens

property.caption: Card Template (HTML)
property.description: HTML template for custom card view. Use {{FieldName}} placeholders for dynamic data. FieldName must match column headers exactly. Leave empty to use default HardenCardView.

property.caption: List Template (HTML)
property.description: HTML template for custom list view. Use {{FieldName}} placeholders for dynamic data. FieldName must match column headers exactly. Leave empty to use default HardenListView.

property.caption: Enable Filter Drawer
property.description: Show a slide-out drawer for filters

property.caption: Custom Formatters
property.description: Define reusable custom formatters that can be used in templates and columns

property.caption: Formatter Name
property.description: Unique name for this formatter (e.g., "statusBadge", "userAvatar"). Use this name in templates like {{formatterName("FieldName")}}

property.caption: Formatter Type
property.description: Type of formatter implementation

property.caption: Formatter Code
property.description: JavaScript function body. Must return a string or HTML. Available variables: value (field value), item (row object), column (column config). Example: return `${value}`;

property.caption: Formatter Config (JSON)
property.description: Optional JSON configuration for this formatter (e.g., color mappings, URL patterns). Accessible as 'config' variable in code.

property.caption: Enable Side Bar
property.description: Show the AG Grid side bar so users can access column and filter panels.

property.caption: Enable Status Bar
property.description: Show the AG Grid status bar with row counts and selection information.

property.caption: Aggregation Footer
property.description: Show a pinned bottom row displaying column aggregations (sum, avg, count, etc.). Configure aggregation per column in the Aggregation section.

property.caption: Enable Row Grouping
property.description: Enable hierarchical row grouping. Configure which columns to group by in the Row Grouping section of each column.

property.caption: Group Default Expanded
property.description: Number of group levels to expand by default. -1 = expand all, 0 = collapse all, 1 = expand first level, etc.

property.caption: Groups on Own Line
property.description: Display group rows on a separate line above the data rows. When disabled, groups appear inline with data.

property.caption: Hide Group Aggregation
property.description: Hide aggregation values on group rows. Useful if you only want to show aggregations in the footer.

property.caption: Row Height Mode
property.description: How to determine row height. Fixed: all rows same height. Auto: rows expand to fit content (requires Wrap Text on columns). Custom: use a JavaScript expression per row. Note: Auto is not supported with Server-Side row model.

property.caption: Row Height (px)
property.description: Row height in pixels. Used as the fixed height when mode is Fixed. Ignored when mode is Auto (rows fit content). Used as a default when mode is Custom.

property.caption: Height Expression (JS)
property.description: JavaScript expression that returns a row height in pixels. Only used when Row Height Mode is Custom. Available variables: data (row object), rowIndex (row number). Example: data.type === 'header' ? 80 : 40

property.caption: Max Row Height (px)
property.description: Maximum row height in pixels (0 = unlimited). Prevents extremely tall rows when using Auto or Custom modes. Recommended: 200-500 for auto-height grids.

property.caption: Row Class Mode
property.description: Apply CSS class names to rows. None: no custom classes. Mapping: map a column value to a class name. Expression: compute class with JavaScript.

property.caption: Row Class Attribute
property.description: Attribute used for row class mapping. Required when Row Class Mode is Mapping.

property.caption: Row Class Mapping (JSON)
property.description: JSON mapping from value to class name. Example: {"Active":"row-active","Inactive":"row-inactive"}.

property.caption: Row Class Rules (JSON)
property.description: JSON rules mapping class names to boolean expressions. Example: {"row-danger":"data.status === 'High'","row-muted":"getValue('Score') < 10"}. This is future-proof for list-based rules UI.

property.caption: Default Row Class
property.description: Optional fallback class when mapping/expression returns nothing.

property.caption: Row Class Expression
property.description: JavaScript expression that returns a class name (string) or array of class names. Available variables: data, rowIndex, getValue(attributeId), columnValue. Example: columnValue === "High" ? "row-danger" : ""

property.caption: Selection Mode
property.description: Control how users can select rows. None: no selection. Single: one row at a time. Multiple: select many rows with checkboxes.

property.caption: Show Checkboxes
property.description: Show checkbox column when Selection Mode is Multiple. Includes a select-all checkbox in the header.

property.caption: Edit Mode
property.description: Choose whether to edit a single cell or the full row at once.

property.caption: Stop Editing on Blur
property.description: Stop editing when the cell loses focus.

property.caption: Enable Undo/Redo
property.description: Enable AG Grid's built-in undo/redo for cell edits.

property.caption: Enable Row Delete
property.description: Show delete actions for grid rows.

property.caption: Allow Bulk Delete
property.description: Allow selecting and deleting multiple rows at once.

property.caption: Show Confirmation Dialog
property.description: Show a confirmation dialog before deleting rows.

property.caption: Dialog Title
property.description: Title text for the delete confirmation dialog.

property.defaultValue: Are you sure you want to delete this row?
property.caption: Dialog Message
property.description: Message shown in the delete confirmation dialog.

property.caption: Show Delete in Toolbar
property.description: Show the delete button in the toolbar.

property.caption: Delete in Context Menu
property.description: Show delete in the right-click context menu.

property.caption: Delete Button Label
property.description: Label text for the delete button.

property.caption: Require Row Selection
property.description: Disable the delete button when no rows are selected.

property.caption: Enable Row Add
property.description: Show an Add button in the toolbar that triggers a Mendix action (e.g. open a new-object page).

property.caption: Show Add in Toolbar
property.description: Show the add button in the toolbar.

property.caption: Add Button Label
property.description: Label text for the add button.

property.caption: AG Grid Version
property.description: The version of AG Grid bundled with this widget. Automatically updated at build time from the installed ag-grid-community package.

property.caption: Version Synced
property.description: Date and time when the AG Grid version was last updated. Automatically set by the build script when the version changes.

property.caption: Widget Build Date
property.description: Date and time when this widget was last built. Automatically stamped on every build/release.

property.caption: Enterprise Key
property.description: Your AG Grid Enterprise license key. Leave empty for Community edition. This value is masked in Studio.

property.caption: Enable Context Menu
property.description: Show the AG Grid right-click context menu for columns and cells. Disable to prevent context menu access.

property.caption: Use Local Storage
property.description: Persist view, filters, search, and sort per user in the browser. Disable to fall back to widget defaults each time.

property.caption: Contains in Toolbar
property.description: Show the "Contains" search field in the toolbar for quick filtering.

property.caption: Toolbar Filter Search
property.description: Enable search/autocomplete functionality within toolbar multi-select filters. Disable for simpler dropdowns.

property.caption: Enable Pagination
property.description: Enable pagination for the grid

property.caption: Page Size
property.description: Number of rows per page

property.caption: Pagination Position
property.description: Where to display the pagination bar

property.caption: Row Buffer
property.description: Number of extra rows rendered above and below the visible area. Higher values reduce flicker when scrolling fast but use more memory. Default: 10.

property.caption: Disable Virtualisation
property.description: When enabled, ALL rows are rendered in the DOM at once (disables virtual scrolling). Only use for small datasets or print layouts. NOT recommended for large datasets.

property.caption: DOM Layout
property.description: Controls grid container behavior. Normal = fixed height with scrolling. Auto Height = grid expands to fit all rows (no scrolling). WARNING: Auto Height disables virtualization and pagination - conflicts with fixed height, pagination, and large datasets. Use only for small grids (<100 rows).

enumerationValues.enumerationValue: Auto Height (expand to fit all rows)

property.caption: Auto-Size Strategy
property.description: How columns are initially sized when the grid loads. None: use per-column width settings. Fit Grid Width: stretch columns to fill the grid. Fit Cell Contents: size columns to fit their content (double-click header border also auto-sizes). Uses AG Grid's native autoSizeStrategy.

property.caption: Skip Header on Auto-Size
property.description: When auto-sizing to fit cell contents, ignore header text width. Only applies when Auto-Size Strategy is "Fit Cell Contents".

property.caption: Persist Column Widths
property.description: Save user-resized column widths to localStorage and restore them on next visit. Requires "Use Local Storage" to be enabled.

property.caption: Height
property.description: Grid height in pixels. Ignored when DOM Layout is set to Auto Height or Print.

property.caption: Theme
property.description: AG Grid theme

property.caption: Theme Variant
property.description: Choose the light or dark variant of the selected theme. Auto follows the user’s system preference.

property.caption: Enable Data Polling
property.description: Automatically check for new data added by other users

property.caption: Polling Interval (sec)
property.description: How often to check for new data (in seconds). Minimum 10 seconds.

property.caption: Enable CSV Export
property.description: Show CSV export button in the toolbar. Exports current grid data (respects filters and sorting).

property.caption: CSV File Name
property.description: Default filename for CSV export (without .csv extension)

property.caption: Export All Columns
property.description: Export all columns. Disable to only export visible columns.

property.caption: Enable Excel Export
property.description: Show Excel export button in the toolbar. Exports to .xlsx format. Requires AG Grid Enterprise license.

property.caption: Excel File Name
property.description: Default filename for Excel export (without .xlsx extension)

property.caption: All Columns (Excel)
property.description: Export all columns to Excel. Disable to only export visible columns.

property.caption: Enable PDF Export
property.description: Show PDF export button in the toolbar. Exports to PDF format using pdfMake.

property.caption: PDF File Name
property.description: Default filename for PDF export (without .pdf extension)

property.caption: PDF Page Orientation
property.description: Page orientation for PDF export

property.caption: PDF Document Title
property.description: Optional title to display at the top of the PDF document (leave empty for no title)

property.caption: Enable Notifications
property.description: Show toast notifications when new data is detected by polling

property.caption: Toast Position
property.description: Where to display toast notifications on screen

property.caption: Auto Hide Duration (ms)
property.description: How long to show notifications before auto-hiding. Set to 0 to require manual dismissal.

property.caption: On Row Click
property.description: Action to execute when a row is clicked

property.caption: On Row Double Click
property.description: Action to execute when a row is double-clicked

property.caption: On Cell Edit Commit
property.description: Action executed after a cell edit is committed. Uses the edited row as context.

property.caption: On Delete Row
property.description: Action executed when a row is deleted.

property.caption: On Add Row
property.description: Action executed when the Add button is clicked (e.g. open a new-object page or run a microflow). No row context — fires on the widget's enclosing object or without context.
